description: This is a unit test class for the DefaultTimesheetAPI in the orangehrmTimePlugin, testing API endpoints related to timesheet retrieval and handling of not implemented methods like delete and update.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A test suite for the DefaultTimesheetAPI, verifying various API behaviors and ensuring not implemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single timesheet entry via the API, utilizing dataProviderForTestGetOne for different cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetOne method from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the delete method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that getting validation rules for delete throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that the update method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for update throws a not implemented exception.
